title: Bills stun Chiefs in final seconds to cap epic Thanksgiving NFL feast

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills stun Chiefs in final seconds to cap epic Thanksgiving NFL feast
sources.description: Tyler Bass hit a 57-yard field goal as time expired and the Buffalo Bills improved their AFC-leading record to 10-1 with a 13-10 victory over the rival Kansas City Chiefs on a rainy, windy and chilly Thursday night.
